Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Bal Vidyalaya and Loreto House are in different countries based on their locations in different states of India (Rajasthan and West Bengal, respectively). The error stems from misunderstanding that states within India are not separate countries; both locations are indeed in India.
